notes_for_editor: Record is the Coeur d'Alene NF site (47.72346, -116.20595), Shoshone County. Other Steamboat Peak lookouts exist in Idaho and were not used: a Payette NF site in Idaho County (1931 12-foot tower, removed; idaholookouts.weebly.com Idaho County M-W page and Idaho Fire Lookouts West Central page, elevation 8,530 ft, destroyed 1966) and an Idaho County site at 45.21270 listed as Tower Gone on firelookout.org. The record's 1950 is only the decade in the sources (1950s), so the story says the 1950s. The 1950 destroyed event was dropped from events because no source gives a year; status_note carries the decade. Sources are thin: no staffing history, no description of the site today, no photo found. Record access 'unknown' could be set to the Idaho site's hike-in label, though that label sits on a destroyed site. Search budget: 2 searches.
